_comment: Baseline delivery plan (owner request 2026-10-04). A sprint is one 8-hour session; sprints run back to back from `start`. Each bar's `start`/`end` are positions on a sprint axis: 0 is the start of sprint 1, 1 the end of sprint 1, 2.5 the middle of sprint 3. `features` lists the F rows whose criteria measure the bar (the redesign row plus F01-F15 rows folded into it). The baseline is frozen; progress is read live from criteria.json. Re-baseline only on an owner decision and record it in `rebaselines`.
rebaselines: 2026-10-04 6:50 PM CDT, before any tracking: baseline measurement corrected. F29#3, F36#0, F36#3 and F47#0 (agent half) were labelled blocked but are agent work. The F49 bars now also measure the 13 chapter cards and the 4 release-wide requirements. Bar dates unchanged.

2026-10-04 7:50 PM CDT (owner): added lane P, a temporary performance lane for sprints 1–4. Codex's desktop timings showed Meadows 11, Tidewake 7 and Stormwood 17 fps average at Medium 1080p. No other bar moved.

2026-10-05 6:15 AM CDT (owner: rebaseline to measured pace, scope kept, old baseline shown as a dashed ghost). Measured at sprint 1.5: F27 and F18 take ~2.0 sprints vs 1.5 planned (pace 1.33: the actor_vitals and portals flips each needed a fix-review-CI loop), F22 ~2.8 vs 2.5, F26 slipped ~0.9 sprint while Codex sat idle 11:45 PM–6 AM CT. Later bars in lanes B, D and E scale by 1.33 and lane C by 1.2; lane A keeps 1.0 (F17 done but #6 blocked on Codex; F31 started at sprint 1.3). F30 shortens to 0.5 (4 of 5 criteria already met). F49 starts when the last feature lane clears (sprint 14.7). Planned finish moves from Fri 9 Oct 2 AM CT (S13) to Sat 10 Oct 10 AM CT (S17).

2026-10-05 9:05 AM CDT: F02 (earned Meadows spine, 7 open rows) moved from lane A's F17 bar to its F49 bar: every open F02 row's audit gap reads 'Folds into F49' (or F47), so F17 was being measured on end-of-pass integrated runs. F01's four open rows stay on F17; they are stale 2026-10-04 re-proofs of criteria F17 has since closed and are being re-run now.

2026-10-06 7:20 AM CDT (owner: 'redo the delivery board based on actual progress'). Measured pace 10-04 6:30 PM → 10-06 7 AM CT: 26 criteria met in ~37 h across 6–9 lanes, about one criterion per lane per 8-hour sprint, Claude and Codex alike. Lanes now match reality: Claude Lane A and F18 finish their bars and archive (owner 10-05: no new Claude lanes); six Codex lanes (root, R1–R5) take their current work, then pull the rest in ROADMAP order. Features over 6 open criteria are split across lanes. Each bar is sized at 1 sprint per open criterion. F49 follows the last feature. Planned finish moves from Sat 10 Oct 10 AM CT (S17) to Thu 15 Oct 12 PM CT (S33). Old bars stay as dashed ghosts.

2026-10-06 12:35 PM CDT: Claude Lane A archived (owner: no more Claude lanes); its F17#6 scene items and hero art move to Codex root (M1). No other dates change.

2026-10-07 9:15 AM CDT (owner): Codex restarted as five sprint lanes A–E from consolidated main b3ad69a; target about 24 hours (lane work ends Thu 08 Oct about 7 AM CDT, owner items after). A criterion counts once evidenced on its lane branch (READY on #572); Claude consolidates to main every 2 hours. Previous plan (finish Thu 15 Oct) kept as history.

2026-10-10 5:45 AM CDT (owner: 'update the delivery plan'): rebaselined to five Claude lanes A–E plus the Codex service from sprint 16.5. Codex lanes retired 10-09. Bars sized from open criteria at ~0.6 criteria per lane per 8-hour sprint (~9/day, mid of the 6–10/day target; overnight 10-09→10-10 actual was 1 criterion, lost ~5 h to the #604 actor_vitals regression and its #613 revert).
